BUT its entire public post history is only 12 photos, and full-resolution review of every one of them found only 4 that are real, own, and free of baked-in marketing text or stock imagery (bk-1, bk-9, bk-11, bk-12): bk-2/3/4/5/7/8/10 are promotional graphics or mid-procedure close-ups with text captions burned into the image (one, bk-7, is a stock photo of a model, not the business's own client), and bk-6 (initially miscounted as clean) also has a caption sentence overlaid. 4 real usable photos is below the pipeline's 5-photo minimum for a non-degraded build, and no priced service menu could be found on any platform (no Booksy/GlossGenius/Fresha/Acuity page for this specific business, only a bare Google/Birdeye profile and this thin Instagram). Rather than pad the gallery with ad graphics or force a site with fabricated pricing, marking this FAILED per PIPELINE.md Fase 3 point 5 / FORGE-BRIEF 0.b.
